scope: fixed-geometry, small-strain, laterally uniform layered column at a supplied axial rate: conservative conduction and once-only creep/plastic dissipation feeding temperature back into the reviewed weakening law; not advection, finite strain, rupture, breakup, global coupling or calibration

provenance.mechanics: reviewed cases/i01_weakening_v1.json (bound by the weakening r2 receipt): layers, densities, rheology, weakening law, gravity, inherited history, axial rate 1e-15/s and total strain 0.04
provenance.thermal: ASPECT cookbooks/continental_extension/continental_extension.prm (main branch, retrieved 2026-09-27): conductivity 2.5 W/m/K, heat capacity 750 J/kg/K, compositional heating 1.0e-6 / 0.25e-6 / 0 W/m3 for upper crust / lower crust / mantle lithosphere, box boundary temperatures 273 K top and 1613 K bottom, and the initial-temperature function constants reproduced under cookbook_constants
provenance.initial_state: discrete steady conduction of this operator with those sources and boundaries; it approximates the cookbook's analytic piecewise-quadratic geotherm (checked in the conduction control)
provenance.heat_partition: all creep and plastic dissipation becomes heat (fractions 1, 1): an explicit D4 choice, not a calibrated rock-specific partition; the cookbook itself does not enable shear heating
provenance.authored: the homogeneous, two-layer eigenmode, uniform-source and refusal fixtures, step counts, the 5 K step guard and every tolerance are authored control inputs, not Earth values

representation.geometry: fixed laterally uniform column; material depth coordinates; small strain; no advection
representation.thermal_support: one control volume per mechanical Gauss point; widths equal its quadrature weight; interfaces exact
representation.conduction: conservative one-dimensional finite volume; series interface resistance; constant per-layer properties
representation.time_integration: exact modal conduction with second-order source quadrature; Heun history; atomic accepted steps
representation.heating: creep plus plastic dissipation of the reviewed law deposited once; radiogenic heat only in the steady reference

mechanics.use: layers, densities, weakening law, gravity, inherited history, supplied axial rate and total strain; its linear temperature profiles are only the preparation template and are replaced by the thermal state

cookbook_constants.source: Function constants ts1-3, qs1-3, A1-3, k1-3 of the cookbook's initial temperature; a check that the layered analytic reference reproduces them
